candidate.name: Edge0-35B-A3B-preview
candidate.notes: 35B sparse MoE (40 layers, 256 experts, 4 active per token, K=4) running in phone-class memory via the edge0 streaming inference framework. Peak active memory 2.9 GiB (measured on Mac mini M4 Pro 24GB, short contexts; long contexts grow the KV cache). Decode 14.9-17.7 tok/s; prefill 113/140 tok/s cold/warm. Checkpoint: int4 base + lora_edge0_35b.safetensors + prerouter_edge0_35b.safetensors. Vendor-run OpenCompass benchmarks (identical settings): avg 79.2 vs 83.2 fp16 base (AIME 2026 86.6, HumanEval 90.9, GPQA-Diamond 79.8, MMLU-Pro 81.0, IFBench 57.9). Framework: edge0 repo, Apache-2.0, MLX backend; native engines for iOS/macOS/Android/Windows released 2026-09-30. One model directory runs unchanged on all four platforms. Preview limitations (their words): agentic/tool-use weak; platform tuning on iOS/Android/Windows still maturing. Paper: arXiv 2609.18063. Repo updated 2026-10-18.

designNote: size check grades WEIGHT bytes (23GB -> 32gb tier), but Edge0 is an SSD-streaming model whose runtime reality is 2.9 GiB active RAM -> 8gb tier. Recommend the pipeline track activeMemoryBytes + offloadKind for streaming models so tier reflects runtime, not disk.
